_metadata.texto_original: Spirit. This spirit memory disguises itself as a harmless animal. It exists only in the Umbra and can use Mokole and Get of Fenris Gifts. If a Mokole kills this creature, he may search his deck for a Quest, Rite or Junta and put it in his hand; shuffle
